pages.title: Two Core Values
pages.text: Every tamed maid with an owner tracks two primary emotional values:$(br2)$(bold)Trust$(): 0–100, representing how much she trusts and feels close to her master.$(br2)$(bold)Fear$(): 0–100, representing how afraid she is of her master.

pages.title: Defaults & Relationships
pages.text: The default values are 40 Trust and 10 Fear. Both change through everyday interactions and events. Different combinations create different relationship states and influence dialogue and special behavior.
